import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
const systemCi = true;
test('gate a', { skip: !systemCi && 'x' }, () => {});
test('outer', async (t) => {
  const booted = existsSync('/run/systemd/system') && process.env.NEVER === '1';
  await t.test('inner', { skip: !booted && 'x' }, () => {});
});
